subscribeBanner.text: this organization has no subscription — paid connectors and included usage open with a subscription.

empty.body: no tools have run yet. connect a client, add a provider key, and your agents start showing up here — calls, quotas, errors, the lot.

stat.errorsSub: across your calls in this workspace

quotas.title: shared quotas
quotas.sub: platform keys you use, with today's burn.

connectClient.d: add mcp.oto.cx to claude desktop, cursor or any mcp client — auth runs over oauth.

firstKey.d: paste a provider key (serper, hunter, …) so your tools can call out.

docs.d: reference pages in an org project — processes, context, conventions. your agents search them before the web.

readme.d: injected at the start of every session: business context, crm rules, tone, guardrails.

org.d: share org keys so teammates inherit your setup.

recent.title: Latest changes
recent.sub: pages and procedures changed in what you can read, most recent first.
recent.empty: no page or procedure changed in what you can read.
recent.error: latest changes could not be loaded: {reason}

account.profileSub: your identity across oto — synced from your login.
account.avatarHint: png, jpeg or webp · drag & drop or click · max 2 MB
account.accessSub: how you sign in — and under which role.
account.accessNote: your account is fixed by your login (claude.ai / Logto). to act under another account, reconnect the OTO connector in claude.ai. the active organization and team are changed from the identity, at the top of the menu.
account.readmeSub: your free-form prose, injected at the start of each agent session — after the platform, org and team ones.
account.readmePlaceholder: e.g. I prefer short answers; my clients are SMBs; sign my emails “Alexis”.
account.privacySub: product analytics — enabled only with your consent.
account.privacyOn: Analytics enabled (PostHog, EU); inputs are masked in recordings. You can withdraw at any time.

login.consoleHelp: sign in with your otomata account to manage your connectors, procedures and org.

sessionExpired.title: session expired
sessionExpired.body: your session has expired — signing you back in…
sessionExpired.fallback: redirect not starting? Sign in again

runner.title: Runner
runner.sub: The worker that takes this organization's executions.
runner.armed: A worker is taking this organization's executions.
runner.notArmed: No runner is taking this organization's executions.
runner.workersHint: A worker identity is a declared secret, not a process: one identity can run several agents.
runner.noModel: no model declared, only executions without a model are taken

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.sub: Each campaign, counted over all of its executions.
campaigns.betaOff: Campaigns are not enabled for this organization.

status.historicalHint: Campaign from the former scheduler: its status never followed, it is read from its executions.
status.armed: armed, waiting for its first execution

campaign.noJobs: No execution attached to this campaign.
campaign.armedIdle: Armed for {duration} without a first execution: no worker is polling this organization's queue.

jobs.expiredHint: nobody took it, this is not a failure

space.label: Automations space navigation
space.notAnId: This address carries no identifier: nothing was asked of the server.

watch.title: To watch
watch.sub: What is running, what is losing occurrences, what has failed.

campaignPage.historySub: All of this campaign's executions, newest first.

schedulePage.readOnly: Read-only view: no setting is offered here.
schedulePage.historySub: All executions started by this schedule, newest first.

executions.title: Executions
executions.sub: All of the organization's executions, newest first.

actions.confirmArm: Arm “{label}”? Procedure, table and model can no longer change.
actions.confirmRelaunch: Relaunch “{label}”? Procedure, table and model can no longer change.
actions.confirmStop: Request the stop? Executions in flight carry on, and keep spending, until they finish.
actions.stoppingSince: Stop requested {duration} ago: it will be recorded at a worker's next pass. Executions in flight keep spending until they finish.
actions.stoppingNoDate: Stop requested: it will be recorded at a worker's next pass. Executions in flight keep spending until they finish.

blocked.historical: No action on a historical campaign. To run it again, ask your agent to declare a new campaign.
blocked.boundReached: No relaunch: bound reached, executions produced: {n} of {max}. A relaunch would produce none. To continue, ask your agent to declare a new campaign.
blocked.consecutiveFailures: No relaunch: stopped after consecutive failures, it would be stopped again without producing anything. To continue, ask your agent to declare a new campaign.

triggers.notTaken: {n} occurrence not taken | {n} occurrences not taken
triggers.effect: Turning off expires the pending occurrences: they will never run. Turning back on resumes the rhythm from now — the due time missed while off is not caught up.
triggers.title: Schedules
triggers.sub: The procedures that start on their own, at a fixed time, and their tap.
triggers.procedureSub: Does this procedure run on its own, and how often?
triggers.empty: No schedule. Ask your agent to create one (“run procedure X every day at 8am”); it will use
triggers.procedureEmpty: This procedure does not run on its own. To start it at a fixed time, ask your agent (“run this procedure every day at 8am”); it will use

form.deleteConfirm: Delete this schedule? Its pending occurrences will never run.
form.deleteNotConfirmed: deletion not confirmed by the server, the schedule stays listed

routines.title: Claude Code routines
routines.sub: An autonomous agent running at Anthropic, with your oto tools plugged in.
routines.empty: No automation configured. Create a routine on {site} (prompt + Oto connector), in its settings add an “API” trigger (Add another trigger → API), generate its token — it is shown only once — then set it here as the credential of the {connector} connector. One routine per automation: the token only fires its own.

run.absent: No in-flight execution carries run {run}: it is no longer running.
run.horsPage: Run {run} is not among the {n} in-flight executions read.
run.erreur: The execution carrying run {run} could not be read: {reason}

modelSub.title: my Claude subscription
modelSub.sub: run your agents on the Claude plan you already pay for (Pro, Max) — “subscription” models: sub:sonnet, sub:opus, sub:haiku.

desc.none: No Claude subscription is connected: your agents can't use the “subscription” models.
desc.connected: Your agents run on your Claude subscription.
desc.connectedPlan: Your agents run on your Claude subscription ({plan} plan).
desc.needs_login: Your Claude session expired at Anthropic: sign in again so your agents resume.
desc.paused: Your plan's usage limit is reached: your agents resume when it resets.
desc.pausedUntil: Your plan's usage limit is reached: your agents are paused until {date}.
desc.disconnected: You signed out: your sandbox is kept, reconnecting is a single sign-in.

modelSub.waiting: {n} job is waiting — it will resume on its own. | {n} jobs are waiting — they will resume on their own.
modelSub.codeStep: Sign in at Anthropic in the tab that just opened, click “Authorize”, copy the code shown and paste it here.
modelSub.teamNote: If you pick a Team or Enterprise organization at Anthropic, that organization pays for the usage, not your personal plan.
modelSub.trust: Your Claude session stays in your sandbox: the platform neither sees nor stores it.
modelSub.notEnabled: This option isn't enabled on your account. The oto team enables it on request.
modelSub.destroyMessage: The sandbox and the Claude session it holds are destroyed. This cannot be undone: coming back means a full sign-in again.

errors.subscription_not_enabled: This option isn't enabled on your account.
errors.login_failed: Anthropic didn't open a session with this code (expired or already used). Click “Start over”.
errors.farm_unavailable: The sandbox service isn't responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.not_connected: No Claude subscription is connected on your account.

errors.datastore_exists: a datastore with that name already exists
errors.duplicate_label: a key with that provider and label already exists
errors.last_org_admin: can't remove or demote the last admin of the org
errors.namespace_not_controlled: that namespace isn't a controlled one
errors.not_a_member: not a member of this org
errors.personal_org: you can't leave your personal space
errors.forbidden: you don't have access to this
errors.stale_session: your session expired — sign in again
errors.view_as_read_only: read-only view — in “view as”, a super_admin can open writing with the “Écrire en tant que …” button of the banner at the top
errors.view_as_write_forbidden: writing on behalf of another account is reserved to super_admin
errors.email_mismatch: this invitation was sent to a different email — sign in with the account that received it
errors.invalid_or_expired: this invitation is invalid, expired, or already used
errors.bad_quiet_hours: quiet hours must be two different hours between 0 and 23
errors.unknown_scheduled_email: this email is gone, already sent, or already cancelled
errors.revision_missing: the server did not serve this row's revision: it cannot be edited without risking overwriting another write

rowEditor.emptyAssumedHint: declare this field deliberately empty — typing a value turns it off
rowEditor.readFailed: the row could not be read for editing: {reason}
rowEditor.invalidField: value refused by the table's schema
rowEditor.locked: this row is reserved by a job in progress: nothing was saved, your draft is kept.
rowEditor.saveFailed: saving failed: {reason} — your draft is kept.

conflict.title: this row changed since you opened it: nothing was saved, your draft is kept.
conflict.rereadFailed: the current version could not be read: {reason}
conflict.takenFromRead: changed elsewhere only: the current version will be taken.
conflict.draftKept: changed in your draft only: your input is kept.
conflict.noDataChange: no column differs in the current version: only the revision moved (a lease taken or released, for instance).
conflict.after: nothing is sent: settle each column changed on both sides, rebase on the current version, then save again.

doc.notFound: page {what} not found in this project
doc.notAnId: the address expects a page id.

table.notFound: table “{raw}” not found in this project
table.notLinked: no table linked to this project has this name or id.
table.pick: none is opened in place of another: pick the one to open.

invited.title: welcome to oto.
invited.createAccount: create your account{email} to get in.
invited.signIn: Already have an account? Sign in

confirm.title: another account.
confirm.body: this invitation was sent to {invited}, but you're signed in as {mine}. continue with this account, or switch.

ok.title: you're {mark}.
ok.joined: you've joined {org} — it's your active space. next step: connect your accounts and add your keys.
ok.open: your access is open. next step: create your workspace.

auditExport.title: access log
auditExport.sub: tool calls made by agents under this org, with who, when, and the result — the record to produce for an audit. kept for 90 days; actions taken in this dashboard are not included.
auditExport.none: no calls in this window. the log is kept for 90 days: an older period is empty, not inactive.
auditExport.fromStart: since the start of the log
auditExport.incomplete: ⚠ {got} rows received for {total} announced: the export is incomplete, don't produce it as is — run it again.
